title: Test vectors: roundtrip tests that encode+decode with same code prove nothing
description: Several tests assert roundtrip correctness using the code under test as its own oracle — the most common pattern being: build an object with code A, serialize with code B, deserialize with code B, assert equality. This proves B is self-consistent but not that it matches any external spec. Affected: fault_store_errors.rs HEAD/BODY/ARTICLE response builders, sieve_tests.rs compile/evaluate cycles, and any test asserting 'encode then decode == original' without a hardcoded expected value. By contrast, core/tests/vectors.rs does this correctly (Python-generated hex digests as the oracle). The fix is not to add more roundtrip tests — it is to replace them with spec-derived expected values.
